build.run: npm run build && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node scripts/check-tree-shaking.mjs

quirks: The devcontainer's postCreateCommand already runs npm ci and installs Playwright's Chromium, which the browser gate needs.
There is no format or separate typecheck script: tsc -b runs inside npm run build, and npm run types:css must run after a CSS Module class is added or removed.
The required check 'quality / Lint, test and build' also runs npm run audit (audit-ci with audit-ci.jsonc's allowlist) and npm run test:coverage; CI never runs npm run test:storybook.

main only accepts squash merges with linear history, resolved review threads and a code owner's approval (.github/CODEOWNERS), and CodeQL code scanning with no security alert of high severity or more and no error or warning alert.

semantic-release publishes to npm only when the commits pushed to main include a feat, fix, perf or breaking change (fix and perf scoped deps or deps-dev excluded, .releaserc.json), and then commits 'chore: release <version> [skip ci]'; a chore: or docs: merge publishes nothing and its issue waits for the next release.
Never bump the version in package.json in a pull request (CONTRIBUTING.md#versioning).

main requires the branch to be up to date with main before merging (strict status checks), and a push dismisses stale approvals, so a pull request behind main is updated and validated again before it merges.
The repository has auto-merge disabled, so pr-handoff.mjs mark-ready cannot enable it: the maintainer merges by hand until it is enabled.
The devcontainer publishes host port 6006 (appPort, Storybook), so only one ui stack can run at a time, the maintainer's own ui container included: stop the other before bringing a worktree stack up.

stack.basis: Estimate: a single typescript-node:22 devcontainer with no services; the peak is the Storybook browser suite running headless Chromium beside Vitest workers, plus about 1 GiB of node_modules and the Chromium download per worktree.
